Egzotik Opsiyonlar: Options shaped according to the demander's needs. Examples of this type are options under the name 'barrier option' that lose their validity if, for instance, the price foreseen in the option for the underlying instrument is passed, or options under the name 'lookback options' that take, for example, the highest price realized in a certain period as the option's price.
Ekonomi: Or by its other name economics: the branch of science researching how individuals and societies use the limited resources at their disposal to meet their broad wants and needs.
Ekonomik birim: Each decision-making member of the households, firms, state and rest of the world that make up the four fundamental components of the economy.
Ekonomik büyüme: The general and permanent increase over time in the quantity of goods and services produced in a country.
Ekonomik dalgalanma: Or the business cycle: the ups and downs seen in total production, income and expenditures within periods of a few years in market economies.
Ekonomik daralma: A period in which total production in an economy shows a general decline.
Ekonomik etkinlik: Deciding, with limited resources, which products will be produced, how, and for whom, in a way that maximizes the social gain.
Ekonomik fazla: The total gain the market provides to buyers and sellers, equal to the sum of consumer surplus and producer surplus.
Ekonomik genişleme: A period in which total production in an economy shows a general increase.
Ekonomik Güven Endeksi: An index summarizing consumers' and producers' assessments, expectations and tendencies regarding the general economic situation, formed by weighting and combining the consumer confidence indicator with the confidence indicators for manufacturing industry (real sector), services, retail trade and construction, adjusted for seasonal effects.
Ekonomik kâr: The profit calculation that takes into account both explicit and implicit expenses.
Ekonomik küreselleşme: The free movement of goods, services, capital, information, technology and people across borders.
Ekonomik sistem: The concept describing how economic decisions are taken in a society or region, and the institutional structure relating to this.
Ekosistem: Refers to the environment in which interrelated groups sharing a particular place, sector or theme bring together the elements that support and facilitate their business ideas.
Eksik bilgi: The situation in which not everyone concerned knows all the information — such as price, quality, quantity and production method — that could affect an economic activity.
Eksik istihdamda olan: Persons who cannot work enough in a paid job, or who cannot fully use their knowledge and skills.
Eksik rekabet: A market structure lacking all the properties required for ideal competitive conditions.
Elde tutma eğilimi: The tendency to sell winning positions early and hold losing ones; the behavioral consequence of the pain of realizing losses (loss aversion).
Elektronik Fon Transfer Sistemi - EFT: The payment system providing the real-time electronic settlement of payment transactions made in Turkish lira. The owner and operator of the EFT system is the CBRT. The EFT System has two components: the Interbank TL Transfer System and the Customer Funds Transfer System. The EFT System operates between 08:00 and 17:30 every weekday except official holidays, and on half working days the system closes at 13:00.
Elektronik Menkul Kıymet Transfer Sistem: The securities settlement system enabling the transfer and settlement of securities among banks electronically, in real time and on a book-entry basis. In the EMKT System, transactions relating to government domestic debt securities and securities issued by some public institutions are carried out. In the transactions made in the EMKT System, the delivery versus payment (DVP) principle applies. Under this principle, the transfer of securities is made simultaneously with the realization of the fund transfer relating to the said securities. The EMKT System operates between 08:00 and 17:30 every weekday except official holidays, and on half working days the system closes at 13:00. The owner and operator of the EMKT System is the CBRT.
Elektronik Para: A monetary value issued in return for funds accepted by the electronic money issuing institution, stored electronically, used to carry out the payment transactions defined in Law No. 6493 on Payment and Securities Settlement Systems, Payment Services and Electronic Money Institutions, and accepted as a means of payment also by real and legal persons other than the electronic money issuing institution.
Elektronik Para Kuruluşu: The legal person authorized to issue electronic money under Law No. 6493 on Payment and Securities Settlement Systems, Payment Services and Electronic Money Institutions.
Emek: Or in short L: the fundamental production factor denoting the physical or mental work and labor performed by people.
Emek arz eğrisi: A graphical tool showing the relationship between the wage level and the quantity of labor supplied, all else being constant.
Emek arz fazlası: Or unemployment: the situation in which the quantity of labor supplied in the labor market exceeds the quantity demanded.
Emek arzı: Or in short SL: the quantity of labor that households offer to the market, depending on different wage rates, in a given period.
Emek kıtlığı: Or excess labor demand: the situation in which the quantity of labor demanded in the labor market exceeds the quantity supplied.
Emek piyasası: Or the labor market: the physical or virtual environment where those who supply labor and those who demand labor come together, and in this process the wage rate of labor is determined.
Emek piyasası dengesi: The situation in which, in a given period, the quantity of labor demanded in the market equals the quantity of labor supplied.
Emek talebi: Or in short DL: the quantity of labor that producers want to employ, depending on different wage rates, in a given period.
Emek talep fazlası: Or labor shortage: the situation in which the quantity of labor demanded in the labor market exceeds the quantity supplied.
Emek verimliliği: The average quantity of output per worker in a given period.
Emeğin marjinal ürün değeri: Or in short MVPL: the revenue obtained from the sale of the additional product brought by increasing the quantity of labor by one unit.
Emeğin marjinal ürün geliri: Or in short MRPL: the change seen in total revenue when the quantity of labor is increased by one unit.
Emeğin marjinal ürünü: Or in short MPL: the change seen in the total quantity of product when the quantity of labor is increased by one unit.
Emeğin ortalama ürünü: Or in short APL: the quantity of product produced per unit of labor in a given period.
Emeğin ücret oranı: Or in short PL: the payment made for using one unit of labor in production.
Emisyon Grubu: The banknote series put into circulation within a particular graphic design approach and size arrangement.
Emisyon Hacmi: The total of the banknotes issued into circulation by the CBRT and in circulation, together with the banknotes that have been withdrawn from circulation but whose 10-year limitation period has not yet expired and that are found in circulation.
Endeksleme: The correction of monetary quantities at certain intervals and automatically according to a price index, by law or by contract.
Enflasyon Hedefi: The annual CPI increase rate set by the CBRT and the Government for three-year periods. The inflation target is defined as the annual inflation in December of each year.
Enflasyon Hedeflemesi: Central banks' targeting, generally together with governments, of a specific inflation figure as the aim of monetary policy. In such a practice, it is envisaged that the targeted inflation, to the extent it can affect expectations, will serve as the nominal anchor. Its difference from other policies is the clear announcement of the inflation target to the public and the taking of direct responsibility in this matter. In practice, as the implementing institution, central banks acquire instrument independence directed toward the aim; in other words, central banks can use exchange rate and interest rate policies as they wish with the aim of bringing inflation under control. Such practices can also emerge as a necessity as a result of all the magnitudes in an economy losing their nominal anchor property. For the success of such a policy, elements such as a strong and healthy fiscal structure, an observable and stable relationship between inflation and monetary policy instruments, credibility, independence, accountability and transparency are counted as prerequisites.
Enflasyon Tahmini: The medium-term inflation forecasts updated by the CBRT every three months within the framework of current data, models and analyses. While the inflation target announced in advance for a certain period is fixed, the inflation forecast is regularly reviewed in the light of new information.
Enflasyon Telafisi: The magnitude that investors demand in order not to suffer real losses, equal to the sum of the inflation expectation and the inflation risk premium.
Enflasyon Vergisi: When money is considered a liability for the institution issuing it into circulation and an asset for the institutions and individuals demanding and holding it, inflation reduces the issuing institution's liability and the holding institution's asset in real terms. In this sense, inflation carries the property of a tax for the earner, and hence, like a tax, causes a transfer of purchasing power.
Enflasyona Endeksli Tahvil: Bonds whose principal and interest payments are linked to a certain price index and which therefore do not suffer a real loss of value. Because the real return of these bonds does not fluctuate despite changes in inflation, offering investors a predictable net return, these bonds are preferred by risk-averse investors.
Enflasyonu artırmayan işsizlik oranı: Or by its widely known short name NAIRU: the unemployment rate that keeps a country's labor market in long-run equilibrium and therefore does not lead to an increase in inflation.
Engel eğrisi: Or the income-consumption curve: a graphical tool showing the relationship between the consumer's income and the quantity demanded of a certain good, all else being constant.
Engel Yasası: The analysis stating that as the income level rises, the share of food expenditures within income will decline.
